recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore ordinalValue or itemWeight extension contexts in core; any R4/R4B compatibility or Extension Pack ordinalValue concern should be handled as a separate work-group decision in the appropriate repository.
issue_request: FHIR-31393 was Published with a Persuasive R5 decision asking to add ValueSet.expansion.contains as a context for the ordinalValue extension so ordinal values could be visible from ValueSet expansions.
initial_application: Core commit 8df9b37980c9dd473e0ebf48bef9cce830725162 added ValueSet.expansion.contains to ordinalValue in source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. Core commit 02d5f0bffcaefadbf7619c9314915307cc4a0444 later renamed ordinalValue to itemWeight for FHIR-24672 while preserving that context.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension rows from current R5 core source. FHIR-33540 later reached a Published/Persuasive with Modification decision to remove CodeSystem.concept, ValueSet.compose.include.concept, and ValueSet.expansion.contains from itemWeight and use concept-properties#itemWeight for CodeSystem/ValueSet weights. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-33540 audit commit, and current core source supports itemWeight as a decimal concept property returned through ValueSet.expansion.contains.property.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Re-adding ValueSet.expansion.contains as an ordinalValue/itemWeight extension context would contradict the later property-based FHIR-33540 decision and duplicate current ValueSet expansion property support.
